title: The CE decalage spectral object compared with derived truncations
statement: For Grothendieck abelian A,B,C with derived categories and additive left exact F:A to B, G:B to C, assign any specified second filtrations L to mapped CE totals [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. The concrete decalage-tower spectral object [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-tower] is naturally isomorphic, as a whole abelian spectral object on EInt, to the Grothendieck derived-truncation spectral object of X. Naturality is for every presentation comparison and every filtered lift of its specified mapped total map. This compares interval objects and connecting maps before taking spectral-sequence pages.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories
source.place: Tag 015X, Remark 13.26.15; Tag 015K, Remark 13.21.4; Tag 0156, Lemma 13.20.1.

proof.text: Construct the natural comparison morphism, invertible on bottom intervals, using the normalized CE augmentations and interval triangle comparisons.

The spectral-object five lemma promotes bottom-interval invertibility to an isomorphism on the whole spectral object. Apply asIso to each comparison morphism; its hom is the original morphism, so presentation naturality gives the stated equation unchanged.

theorem cartanEilenberg_decalage_spectralObject
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vB} B]
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vC} C]
    [HasDerivedCategory A] [HasDerivedCategory B] [HasDerivedCategory C]
    (F : A ⥤ B) (G : B ⥤ C) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteLimits G]
    (L : ∀ P : CartanEilenbergPresentation F, DecreasingFiltration (P.total G))
    (hL : ∀ (P : CartanEilenbergPresentation F) (p n : ℤ),
      (L P).complexStep p n =
        ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).obj P.I).secondFiltration n).step p)) :
    ∃ e : ∀ P : CartanEilenbergPresentation F,
      (filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj
          (⟨P.total G, L P⟩ : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)) ≅
        F.grothendieckSpectralObject G P.X,
      ∀ (P Q : CartanEilenbergPresentation F) (d : P.Comparison Q)
        (t : (⟨P.total G, L P⟩ : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)) ⟶
          (⟨Q.total G, L Q⟩ : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ))),
        t.hom = HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
          ((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).map d.α) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) →
        (filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).map t ≫ (e Q).hom =
          (e P).hom ≫ (F.grothendieckSpectralObjectFunctor G).map d.f
